The Trump administration had a problem; most immigrants show up for their court hearings and fight their cases. That's bad for the Trump admin, which wants to rapidly generate removal orders.

posts.text:
Say you're a bush pilot flying food, clean water, and medicine to a remote town. One day, you decide you just don't feel like doing it. People in the town die because they didn't get meds in time.

Are you responsible for those deaths? Bremmer says "obviously" no. I say obviously, undoubtedly, yes.
